meta.title: Bitcoin Liquidity & Infrastructure Dashboard
meta.description: Illustrative placeholder metrics for reading Bitcoin through liquidity, scarce-asset demand, and power-to-AI infrastructure — not a live market feed.
meta.source_note: All figures are round illustrative placeholders for educational framing. They are not live API quotes, not trading signals, and not investment advice.
meta.disclaimer: Educational research only. Not individualized financial advice. Numbers may lag or be stylized for teaching the framework.

buckets.label: Macro liquidity
buckets.framing: Higher rates = near-term headwind for BTC. Don't fight the liquidity math.

buckets.label: Scarce-asset / debasement
buckets.framing: Institutional flows despite elevated real rates make the monetary-infrastructure thesis more interesting.

buckets.label: Bitcoin infrastructure
buckets.framing: Stop treating miners as leveraged BTC proxies. Ask how much the power portfolio earns per MW after converting mining → AI compute.

metrics.label: Fed funds rate
metrics.why_it_matters: Policy rate sets the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding scarce assets.
metrics.source_note: Illustrative placeholder — not a live Fed quote.

metrics.label: 10-year real yield
metrics.why_it_matters: Real yields compete directly with BTC as a long-duration scarce claim.
metrics.source_note: Illustrative placeholder — stylized TIPS-style real yield.

metrics.label: 30-year Treasury yield
metrics.why_it_matters: Long-end yields anchor discount rates and risk appetite across risk assets.
metrics.source_note: Illustrative placeholder — not a live Treasury quote.

metrics.label: BTC ETF net flows
metrics.why_it_matters: Spot ETF flows show whether institutions keep adding despite elevated real rates.
metrics.source_note: Illustrative 30-day net-flow placeholder — not a live ETF tape.

metrics.label: BTC vs. gold performance
metrics.why_it_matters: Relative performance vs. gold tests the scarce-asset / debasement framing.
metrics.source_note: Illustrative YTD relative-return placeholder — not live prices.

metrics.label: AI revenue per MW (ex-miners)
metrics.why_it_matters: Shows what former mining power portfolios may earn after pivoting to AI compute.
metrics.source_note: Illustrative industry-style placeholder — company disclosures vary widely.
